reviewed_routes.route_origin_note: The Shandong-domain API/front routes are first-party-domain route locators; the old object-host path template is secondary-locator-derived and was used only to test reachability, never as bibliographic authority.

cross_egress_probe.interpretation: Cross-platform/cross-region GitHub-hosted runners could not establish a response from the reviewed Shandong routes. adjudication.reason: The 1594/Weifang locator is research-significant, but no first-party response or page bytes were obtained from any reviewed execution path. Reachability failure cannot be converted into textual or bibliographic absence.

next_gate: Obtain a first-party Shandong/Weifang catalog or object response for resource 151613020240003 through a reachable network/archive route, then bind title, edition, holding and page bytes before treating it as a direct witness.
If the target leaf becomes readable, directly collate it without OCR for glyph authority and compare it to the AW 1594 NIJL/Tohoku physical witness.
